_about: AEC-certified division summaries for the 1993, 1996 and 1998 federal elections — per division: enrolment, formal/informal/total vote + printed percentages and their swings, turnout and the AEC's own division-level Labor-v-Coalition two-party-preferred pair (votes, ALP share, swing, exhausted ballots). The 1993 block is REAL at this grain: the booth-level HTPPBYPP product for 1993 is informal-votes-only, but DIVS.TXT's division-level TPP pair is the certified count and the finest 1993 TPP grain published. Swing cells the AEC printed empty (a division with no prior-election comparator, e.g. Namadgi 1996) are null, not 0. 1998 Newcastle's five TPP cells are null — the AEC counted no Labor-v-Coalition pair there (final pair Labor v independent), matching the family's HTPP exclusion; never reconstructed. This is a summary layer — first-preference tables live in the family's houses (hcands/booth fpv), full cascades in dop-<year>.csv.gz.
